name: @orc/desktop
description: orc desktop app - Electron shell around the orc daemon
author: Nir Adler

scripts.bundle: bun build src/main.ts --outdir dist --target node --format esm --external electron
scripts.dist: bun run bundle && bun run bin --only host && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: bun run bundle && bun run bin --only mac-arm64,mac-x64 && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64
scripts.dist:win: bun run bundle && bun run bin --only windows-x64 && electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:linux: bun run bundle && bun run bin --only linux-x64,linux-arm64 && electron-builder --linux --x64 --arm64
